home.title: Your book, only more yours.
home.subtitle: A digital editor that spots errors, inconsistencies and weak passages without rewriting your voice. Every suggestion stays under your control.
home.previewOriginal: The room was very quiet, with a silence that almost seemed alive.
home.previewProposal: The room held a silence that felt almost alive.
home.previewReason: Removes redundancy while preserving the author’s chosen image.
home.methodTitle: It understands first. Then it suggests.
home.step1Body: Chapters, characters, timeline and style become a coherent memory of the book.
home.step2Body: Language, style and continuity are assessed separately, each with an explicit confidence level.
home.step3Title: Leaves the final word to you
home.step3Body: No substantial rewrite is applied without a conscious decision from the author.

workspace.title: Welcome back.
workspace.subtitle: Upload a new draft. We will assess its structure and size before proposing timing and review type.
workspace.formats: DOCX, TXT, Markdown or EPUB · up to 50 MB
workspace.memoryBody: Voice, characters, places and narrative rules.
workspace.controlBody: Approve, reject or edit every suggestion.

intake.title: New manuscript
intake.formats: DOCX, TXT or Markdown · up to 50 MB
intake.retention: This preflight runs in memory: the file is not stored yet.
intake.budgetNote: Estimate based on roughly {tokens} pipeline tokens. The final quote will depend on the selected models.
intake.comingSoon: Project persistence is coming in the next increment.

errors.UNAUTHORIZED: Your session has expired. Sign in again.
errors.FILE_TOO_LARGE: The file exceeds the 50 MB limit.
errors.UNSUPPORTED_FORMAT: Unsupported format. Use DOCX, TXT or Markdown.
errors.EMPTY_MANUSCRIPT: The document contains no readable text.
errors.PARSE_FAILED: The document is unreadable or damaged.

sampleReview.title: Try AI editing
sampleReview.description: Review the first 12,000 characters with OpenRouter. The sample is sent to the AI provider only when you start; this uses your OpenRouter credit. This trial covers language and style, not whole-book continuity.
sampleReview.wait: This may take up to 90 seconds. Keep this page open.
sampleReview.discarded: {count} proposals excluded because their source text could not be verified.
sampleReview.empty: No verifiable proposals returned. This does not certify that the text is error-free.
sampleReview.retention: The download includes approved edits only, as plain text. Original unchanged. Results and decisions stay on this page and are lost on reload.

errors.NOT_CONFIGURED: OpenRouter key is not configured. Restart the development server.
errors.CREDITS: AI service temporarily unavailable. Contact support.
errors.BUSY: A review is already running or the provider is busy. Try again shortly.
errors.PROVIDER: Review could not complete. Try again; check your model and OpenRouter availability if this persists.
errors.DISABLED: The trial is available only in development.

editor.outlineEmpty: Apply heading styles to your chapters to find them here.
editor.deviceNote: Drafts stay in this browser. Export a copy to keep them elsewhere.
editor.author: Author
editor.libraryIntro: Every good story deserves its best version.
editor.libraryHeroBody: An editor by your side, from the first revision to the final page. You stay in control.
editor.emptyBody: Drop your draft or import a document. A space to read, refine and make it yours.
editor.libraryPrivacy: Your manuscript is private. Text reaches AI only when you start a review.
editor.noOriginal: The original is not available for this project.
editor.importExplanation: Import text, headings, lists, tables, supported images and character formatting. Your original stays available separately.
editor.importLimit: Bookr reconstructs an editable document: layout, unavailable fonts, headers, fields, comments and Word revisions may change. Notes may become plain text. Check the import before proceeding; it is not an exact copy of the Word layout.
editor.importNotice: Document reconstructed for editing. Check notes and layout; the original file is always available.
editor.heading: Heading {level}
editor.reviewingLocked: Review in progress. Text stays unchanged until the review finishes.
editor.pausedLocked: Review paused. Resume or stop to edit the text.
editor.reviewDescription: Reasoned language and style proposals. You choose which ones become part of your book.
editor.allResolved: You have evaluated every available proposal. Select All to revisit them.
editor.waitingFindings: The first suggestions will appear here during the review.
editor.noSuggestions: Start a review to receive proposals. No edits are applied automatically.
editor.stale: Text changed: review this proposal again
editor.discarded: {count} proposals excluded because their position in the document could not be verified.
editor.reviewEntireBook: A full read of your text.
editor.reviewConsent: Your manuscript will be sent to OpenRouter in {blocks} blocks, using your API key credit. Progress is saved after each block: keep this tab open or pause and resume later.
editor.reviewLimit: This pass covers language and style throughout the text. It does not certify the absence of errors or check narrative continuity across chapters yet. Review typography in the Format panel.
editor.newPassNotice: A new pass replaces the previous suggestion list. Approved edits stay in the document.
editor.exportTitle: Your book, in its new version.
editor.exportDescription: Download the entire manuscript as DOCX, with the current text, chosen formatting and approved edits. Rejected and pending proposals do not change the text.
editor.exportIncomplete: The review is not finished. You can still export the document in its current state.
editor.typographyDescription: A consistent rhythm on the page. These settings apply to your document and exported DOCX.
editor.normalizeNote: Removes local font overrides to use the document style. Keeps bold, italics and headings. Undo using the toolbar.

errors.STORAGE: Local saving is unavailable. Export your DOCX before closing and check browser storage.
errors.UNSUPPORTED_FORMAT: Choose a DOCX, TXT or Markdown file.
errors.EMPTY_MANUSCRIPT: The document contains no readable text.
errors.IMPORT: Import failed. Check that the file is readable and not password protected.
errors.EXPORT: Export failed. Some images may use an unsupported format; check your document and try again.
errors.NOT_CONFIGURED: OpenRouter key not configured. Restart the server after adding it.
errors.API_KEY: The OpenRouter key is not valid.
errors.CREDITS: AI service temporarily unavailable. Contact support.
errors.BUSY: Another review is active. Open its manuscript to pause or stop it.
errors.UNAUTHORIZED: Your session expired. Sign in again.
errors.PROVIDER: This block could not complete. Earlier results are saved: press Resume to try again.
errors.DISABLED: AI review is available only in the development environment.

bookData.title: Book details
bookData.description: Identity, publication and credits. All fields are optional and saved with the draft.
bookData.exportHint: Pages are added before the manuscript using only completed fields. Turn these off if the draft already contains them.
bookData.authorsHint: One author per line, in the desired order. Pen names are welcome.

editor.approveAllTitle: {count, plural, one {Approve this revision?} other {Approve # revisions?}}
editor.approveAllDescription: Pending proposals will be applied together. Proposals that no longer match the text will be skipped. You can undo the entire operation with Undo.
editor.wholeBookDescription: Full reading, chapter map, cross-section consistency and language editing with a second check of proposals.
editor.wholeBookConsent: The full text is sent to OpenRouter for reading, summaries, structural analysis and editing. Progress is encrypted on the local development server. Proposals remain subject to approval.
editor.serverContinues: Processing continues while the development server is running, even with this tab closed.

jobErrors.BUDGET: Processing paused by the service limit. Contact support.
jobErrors.INVALID_RESPONSE: Invalid response. Resume from the last saved step.
jobErrors.CREDITS: AI service temporarily unavailable. Contact support.

structure.title: Chapters and contents
structure.heading: Heading {level}
structure.noHeadings: No chapters recognized. Select chapter titles and apply a Heading style using the toolbar.
structure.moveHint: Arrows move the whole chapter, including its text. Undo is available in the toolbar.
structure.contentsHint: Contents follow Heading styles. Links are included; Word calculates page numbers when updating the contents field. Disable this if you want to keep only an existing contents page in the draft.
structure.emptyContents: Apply Heading styles to generate entries.
structure.stale: Text or structure changed after this analysis. Run a final check to refresh it.
structure.decisionHint: Structural suggestions are an editorial plan: accepting them does not rewrite the text automatically. Consistency analysis does not verify external sources.
structure.replaceExisting: Replace detected contents in the exported DOCX
structure.intro: Recognize an existing contents section, link headings and prepare your book structure. These tools run locally and do not start an AI review.
structure.checkDescription: Analyze order, transitions and consistency using OpenRouter and the spending limit below. Text is sent to the provider only when you start this check.
structure.referenceMissing: Heading reference is no longer available: refresh the structural check.

detectContents.none: No contents section recognized with sufficient confidence. You can apply Heading styles manually.
detectContents.ambiguous: Multiple matches: select the correct one or leave this entry excluded.
detectContents.hint: Confirmation applies Heading styles to selected passages and makes them navigable in the outline. The original contents text remains in the document.

pages.hint: A4 page references for the text displayed in the editor. Word recalculates pagination in the exported DOCX.
